svg.title: The trust boundaries of the website
svg.desc: Six boundaries. 1, a pull request reaches main only through the ruleset of main and every required check. 2, the Docs workflow builds the website from main with tools from PyPI that are pinned by their hashes, and downloads the fonts from Google Fonts, Mermaid from unpkg and the search indexes of the project websites while it builds, and reads the notes of the latest releases of every project from api.github.com, of which it keeps only text, lists, headings, tables, code, quotes and https links. 3, its deploy job alone publishes the website, in the environment github-pages, which accepts main alone, with a short-lived OIDC token. 4, GitHub Pages serves this website at the root of dennis-otto.github.io, on the same origin as the project websites, which their own repositories build and publish. 5, your browser gets the pages over HTTPS and asks api.github.com for the number of public repositories. 6, the install links lead to HACS, the Nextcloud App Store and GitHub.
